Record Class CellStyle

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.schladebeck.fx.grid.render.CellStyle
Record Components:
background - background color, or null
textFill - text color, or null
font - font, or null
fontWeight - weight such as FontWeight.BOLD, or null
fontPosture - posture such as FontPosture.ITALIC, or null
alignment - horizontal alignment, or null to let the renderer decide
public record CellStyle(javafx.scene.paint.Color background, javafx.scene.paint.Color textFill, javafx.scene.text.Font font, javafx.scene.text.FontWeight fontWeight, javafx.scene.text.FontPosture fontPosture, javafx.geometry.HPos alignment) extends Record

Immutable style of a cell or a column header. A null component means "use the grid default". Create instances once and share them: a CellStyleProvider should return constants, not build a new style per cell.

fontWeight and fontPosture change the font the cell would have otherwise, its own font or the grid's, and keep its family and size. So a bold cell stays as large as its neighbors when the theme changes the grid's font size.
